_comment: Exceptional Financial Support (capitalisation direction) awards, ALL years, cross-checked 2026-08-07 directly against each year's dedicated gov.uk guidance page (not just the 2025-26 page's own historical summary, which turned out incomplete) plus a news report for Gloucester's award breakdown. Source URLs per year below.
_relevance_note: Two of the 17 GM/Gloucestershire authorities have needed EFS: Trafford (2025-26 AND 2026-27 — two consecutive years, amount increasing) and Gloucester (2026-27 only, £9.05m — missed entirely by the first pass of this research, which only checked the 2025-26 list). Manchester still doesn't appear in any year despite having thinner reserves than either. No other GM or Gloucestershire authority appears in any year 2022-23 to 2026-27.

gm_gloucestershire_awards.note: support agreed in-principle; second consecutive year

support agreed in-principle. News reporting (soglos.com, 25 Feb 2026) breaks the wider £15.5m package down as £9.05m primary allocation + £3.89m covering 2024-25 + £2.56m covering 2025-26 — only the £9.05m 2026-27 figure appears on gov.uk's own table, the rest is not yet independently confirmed against a primary document.

_full_lists_not_reproduced: This file only carries GM/Gloucestershire-relevant rows to keep it small — full national EFS lists run to ~30 authorities per year and are the primary source's job to maintain, not a copy pasted in here to go stale. If the scope ever expands beyond GM/Gloucestershire, re-fetch the source URLs above rather than trust this file for other authorities.
